body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and the target burns 1 die from its available pool.

surges.html: On a success, the target burns 1 die from its available pool.
Gain +1 Defense against the primary target until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: BREAKER
rider.html: If this Action succeeds, you may spend 1 Combo to make the target Exposed.
